name: SDA
summary: SDA, also known as 3,4-methylenethiooxyamphetamine (3T-MDA), is a putative entactogen and psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA). It is the analogue of MDA in which the oxygen atom at the 3 position within the 3,4-methylenedioxy substitution has been replaced with a sulfur atom to give a 1,3-benzoxathiole rather than 1,3-benzodioxole ring system.

pharmacology.text: SDA had largely similar activational efficacies at the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors as MDA. Due to its greater potency as a monoamine releasing agent, SDA may be active at lower doses or concentrations than MDA. SDA produced hyperlocomotion and hyperthermia in rodents and to a greater extent than SDMA or MDMA. However, SDA did not produce significant rewarding effects in the conditioned place preference (CPP) paradigm unlike MDMA but similarly to SDMA.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Entactogen; Stimulant; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is a research compound with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Entactogens of this family can cause jaw clenching, a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, dangerous overheating, low mood in the days after use, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這一類同感藥可能引起咬牙、心跳加快、血壓升高、危險的體溫過高、使用後幾天情緒低落，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这一类同感药可能引起咬牙、心跳加快、血压升高、危险的体温过高、使用后几天情绪低落，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: SDA is MDA with the two oxygen atoms of its ring swapped for sulfur. Such swaps of one atom for another in the same column of the periodic table are called bioisosteric replacements.
fact.zh: SDA 是把 MDA 環上的兩個氧原子換成硫。這種把元素週期表同一族的原子互相替換的做法，稱為生物等排置換。
fact.zhHans: SDA 是把 MDA 环上的两个氧原子换成硫。这种把元素周期表同一族的原子互相替换的做法，称为生物等排置换。
